svg.title: Grounding with RAG
svg.desc: Sequence between the user, the AI model and your data (SharePoint or a database). 1: the user asks the AI model "What is our Q3 sales number?". 2: the AI model retrieves relevant chunks from your data. 3: your data returns "Q3 sales: $4.2M (from report)". 4: the AI model answers the user "Your Q3 sales were $4.2M, up 12% YoY".
svg.text: The model retrieves from your data before it answers, so the reply is grounded and current.
